notes: All 7 web searches in this run ran (the six required plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors). None of them found any statement by Rick W. Allen on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause or slowdown, an agreement with China, or AI safety; the 'AI safety' search only returned similarly named people (Greg Allen of Decision Tree Research, Gregory Allen of the Wadhwani AI Center), who are not this representative. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, Casar): cosponsor lists seen in search results (FastDemocracy, Forkast, Nextgov via aiunderstanding.org) disagree with each other but none names Allen; Congress.gov was not opened, so this is not fully confirmed. The three statements below were carried over from an earlier run that opened his official site directly; that run's news list (Aug to Nov 2026) showed no AI items. In the 2026-07-24 release he also said 'If the United States intends to win the AI race, we must continue these critical discussions and ensure this technology remains a tool that serves Americans.' (D, competition). His opening statement for the same hearing is also posted at https://edworkforce.house.gov/uploadedfiles/opening_statement_for_rep_allen.pdf (not opened).
